full_details: On the step at Field's you asked whether a chronicle might be spared in Lent. A forme was on the press. He made you name the day it would come home. You did not name one. You will ask again in Lent. At the Cross Keys the owl's one stop held, and no word of the songs was changed. Nick has the Princess, and her first long speech waits for Thursday. You played no line of the new comedy aloud. At noon John called from a mercer's in Cheapside. The gown is watchet taffeta with copper lace, fifty shillings, half down asked and not paid. The stock has eleven shillings in it till Saturday. You agreed to take it on credit against the Queen's twenty pounds, whenever those come. Nick was being measured beside John, not in the room with you. You told him to keep you both. In the afternoon you played in Fair Em. The Rose billed Wise Man. You did not go. At home you set the fifty shillings under Edith's old eight on the tables. Nothing was paid. The groats were still unsewn.
one_sentence: You left Field's book on the shelf, rehearsed at nine, and took the Princess's gown on credit for fifty shillings.
title: Asked Field for a chronicle and took the gown on credit
